newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Electronic names Paulfus CFO.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Electronic names Paulfus CFO.

text.p: Advanced Electronic Support Products Inc said Thursday it named Randall Paulfus chief financial officer.
Advanced Electronic also said it appointed Martin Gerber vice president of retail sales and marketing.
The computer networking products company said Paulfus and Gerber are both joining Advanced Electronic to fill newly created positions.
Paulfus has worked as a consultant for Lissner Associates Ltd and for Intel, the company said. Gerber's background includes jobs with Sharp Electronics Corp and Gemini Industries Inc.
